9304: Sit at the pulldown station with your thighs under the pads.
Grab the wide neutral grip handles.
Lean back slightly and keep your chest up.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the handles rise slowly with control.
9310: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Hold the top position for 20 to 30 seconds.
Keep your ankles straight and stable.
9311: Start in a push-up position with hands wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest until your elbows are bent.
Hold this position for 10 to 20 seconds.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Press back up to the start.
9312: Set a bar at about waist or chest height.
Place your hands on it slightly wider than your shoulders.
Walk your feet back so your body is in a straight line.
Lower your chest to the bar.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core and glutes tight.
9313: Hang or set yourself up with the rings under your forearms.
Brace your core and tuck your pelvis.
Move into the rollout position and stop.
Keep your body in a straight line.
9314: Set the pad at hip height and lock your heels in.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Hinge forward at the hips with a straight back.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
9315: Stand a stride length in front of a bench and rest your back foot on it.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your foot.
Drive through the front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
9316: Set the rings low and put your hands on them with your feet on a box.
Raise your hips into a pike shape.
Lower your head between the rings.
Keep the rings steady and close to your body.
Press back up to straight arms.
9317: Set up a bar so you can sit under it.
Grab the bar with an overhand grip.
Pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar.
9318: Lie on a mat and hold something fixed behind your head.
Raise your body into a straight line on your upper back.
Lower your body slowly keeping it straight.
Bring your legs back up and reset.
9319: Lie on a mat and hold something fixed behind your head.
Lift your hips and tuck your knees.
Lower your body slowly with bent knees.
9320: Grip the bar with palms facing you and hands close together.
Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar.
Keep your shoulders down and core tight.
9321: Lie on your back with your legs straight and hands under your hips.
Lift your feet a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small alternating motions.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
9322: Lie on a mat and hold something fixed behind your head.
Raise your body into a straight line with one leg tucked.
Lower slowly while keeping your hips level.
9323: Stand in front of a bench with your feet wide and toes turned out.
Push your hips back and lower down.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels to stand.
9324: Stand tall holding a support if needed.
Stop when your hips begin to tilt.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower it slowly and switch legs.
9325: Start in a straight-arm plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lower halfway down until your elbows are bent.
Hold the position for 10 to 20 seconds.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
9359: Lie on your back with one foot flat and the other leg raised.
Press your heel into the floor.
Lift your hips until your body forms a line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
9385: Lie on a bench under the smith bar with a shoulder width grip.
Unrack the bar over your chest.
Lower the bar toward your chin or upper chest by bending your elbows.
Use a light weight and control the path.
9387: Sit on the machine and place one foot on the platform.
Lower the platform until your knee is bent about 90 degrees.
Press through your heel to push it back.
Do not lock your knee at the top.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
9398: Stand in the machine with your hands on the handles.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch.
Keep your chest tall and your back still.
